high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene of a modern building with a distinctive architectural design. The building features a facade made up of vertical wooden slats that create a textured pattern. The lighting is warm and focused on the building's exterior, highlighting the wooden slats and creating a contrast against the dark night sky. The most prominent feature on the building is the illuminated sign that reads "alo" in large, white, lowercase letters. The sign is mounted on the building's facade and stands out prominently due to its bright illumination.
